items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: And Trumpy Young used to come around and play. So finally the guy hired the whole thing. We had a six piece band.

ctx.x: -- Well I had this little trio, can't even count that, that's not even counted as far as jazz, that little Wynken Blynken and Nod thing. That was a step in the right direction I guess you'd say. But my first little group of my own was right on 52nd St. Right after the Tatum thing broke up. And I got plenty of jobs down there ... Trommy Young, John Herder, Marlow Morris, they were all good players, man. Who else, Jimmy Butts, Al Haig was there. Also Clyde Hart at one time or another. So that was my first thing as…
What made you decide to get your own group together?
Now that's a question I don't -- I mean by me hangin' out down there, a guy asked me to have a band, or 'could I get a group together, you know.'
